item.title: We came a long way 🫶🏻
item.description:
We came a long way 🫶🏻

Not long now before it’s finished!! Can’t wait to show you all how absolutely INSANE the end result will be.

Big thank you to @masterpiecemiami for doing such an amazing job on my custom seats, bodywork & paintjob.

Now off to NY, to finish the engine with @brooklyncoachworks 👌🏻

item.title: Thank you everyone for your 🫶🏻 on my YouTube videos!
item.description:
Thank you everyone for your 🫶🏻 on my YouTube videos!

This project is so much fun for me & I decided to film this process to keep as a memory forever - & I am so happy to see you all enjoy it as well ❤️🙏🏻 just a few more weeks!! Can’t wait to show you all the finished 90!
